o1: Predicted to enable frizzled binding activity. Involved in several processes, including cell fate specification; inductive cell migration; non-canonical Wnt signaling pathway; and establishment or maintenance of cell polarity. Is located in cell cortex. Is expressed in several structures, including distal tip cell; head; hypodermis; posterior lateral left ganglion; somatic gonad precursor; and B cell. Is part of the Wnt/planar cell polarity signaling pathway. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in DiGeorge syndrome; autosomal dominant Robinow syndrome 2; autosomal dominant Robinow syndrome 3; and lung cancer. Orthologous to human DVL1 (dishevelled segment polarity protein 1); DVL2 (dishevelled segment polarity protein 2); and DVL3 (dishevelled segment polarity protein 3).
